definitions.explanation: Deep feelings of care and attachment. Can refer to romantic love or familial affection.

examples.japanese: {愛情|あいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦{作|つく}りました→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛情|あいじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: My love for my children is deep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{愛情|あいじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many things about a parent's love that you only understand after you grow up.

notes:
{愛情|あいじょう} refers to deep emotional attachment and caring. It covers both romantic love between partners and the affection of a parent for a child. Unlike ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧, which is a broader, more abstract concept, {愛情|あいじょう} emphasizes the warmth and emotional depth of the feeling.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {愛情|あいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注|そそ}ぐ→注ぐ：02124_sosogu⟧: to pour love into (children, a project)
- {愛情|あいじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧: with love, with care
- {愛情|あいじょう}⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: expression of affection
- {愛情|あいじょう}⟦{深|ぶか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧: deeply loving, affectionate
- {愛情|あいじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧: lacking in affection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧: love (broad, abstract concept)
- ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧: romantic love specifically
- ⟦{情|じょう}→情：03343_jou⟧: emotional feeling, compassion
- ⟦{愛着|あいちゃく}→愛着：04858_aichaku⟧: attachment (to objects or places)

REGISTER:
Neutral to slightly formal. Common in writing and conversation about family, relationships, and parenting.
